sections.Profile:
New World and Conquest 200 are electro-mechanical pinball machines released by Spanish manufacturer Playmatic in October 1976. New World is the four-player version, while Conquest 200 is the single-player counterpart.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Western, Dual Theme, Original Theme, Imperialism , 1970s, History
